question: Is 'applying text-graph/self-bootstrapping mechanisms as fine-tuning supervision for multi-hop KGQA' a sufficient contribution, or must the research question be repositioned?
description: With distinction (2) established as 'text graph' / KG-construction-from-text prior art and distinction (3) as generic self-bootstrapping, the surviving original element is only the application of these to fine-tuning supervision for multi-hop KGQA. Whether that application-level combination is a sufficient contribution, or whether the work should instead be positioned as a text-graph supervision study (with the KG framing dropped), is unresolved and affects the direction.
rationale: After the U013 challenge, both distinctive mechanisms map to established families (text-graph construction; process-supervision self-bootstrapping), so the contribution rests entirely on the training-time application, which the critique already judged to need hop-depth splitting and matched-budget controls.
